mechanism: Berberine is a CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase duloxetine plasma concentrations, and both agents have mild antiplatelet/bleeding effects.
action: Monitor for duloxetine toxicity signs (nausea, dizziness, serotonin effects); consider duloxetine dose reduction if using high-dose berberine; counsel on bleeding precautions.
